item.title: How Can We Move Beyond the Limits of Our Self-Image?
item.description: Our self-image shapes how we see ourselves and the world, yet it can also limit our growth and inner freedom. By cultivating self-awareness, practicing self-acceptance, and stepping beyond the comfort zone, we can transform limiting beliefs and rediscover our deeper potential, authenticity, and connection with life.
